events.region: Bullock, AL; Macon, AL; Montgomery, AL
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Montgomery County in south central Alabama...
Northwestern Bullock County in southeastern Alabama...
Southwestern Macon County in southeastern Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 100 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable. Ponding of water in
urban or other areas is occurring or is imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1005 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Southeastern Montgomery, Pike Road, Waugh, Hardaway, Mount Meigs,
Auburn University In Montgomery, Liverpool, Cecil, Mitchell,
Cross Keys and Barachias.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Northeastern Bottineau County in north central North
Dakota...

* WHEN...Until 1030 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 927 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 4 inches of rain is
estimated to have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bottineau, Souris, Landa, Carbury, Roth, Pelican Point State
Recreation Area and Lake Metigoshe State Park.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
